description: source-identity@1 (DR-248: Vektor-Stores wiederaufnehmen und feste Partitionen schreiben). Class D1: absolute cost per GiB of fse._encoder._resume.identify(source, None), the fingerprint, the row count and the line marks of a source, from an opened source until the identity is done (encoding and writing are not included). Cell 1: a 1 GiB text file of the pinned WikiText-103 training sentences, warm page cache, read completely before every repetition. Cell 2: a list of 10^6 sentences of the same source, form strings. One warm-up call, repetitions and median with IQR from --descriptive-repetitions (7), one worker. Descriptive only, no comparison claim, no decision gate. Local development only, candidate build only.
